snippet.title: Find This Pixel Anomaly - Announcement Trailer | Steam
snippet.description:
Find This Pixel Anomaly is a cozy-horror game where you have to monitor surveillance camera footage to spot anomalies. Have you seen anything suspicious? File a report to fix it. But beware - too many anomalies will end the game.

🎮 Play the demo on Steam
https://store.steampowered.com/app/3290400/Find_This_Pixel_Anomaly/

🦋 Follow on Bluesky
